title: ESIC (India) — Annual repairs and maintenance of civil works, Hyderabad: Notice Inviting e-Tender, CPWD format (2023), pages 3-5
labelled_by: Claude (AI-assisted), line by line against the parser output; independent human review pending
notes: Employees' State Insurance Corporation, central government building-works tender in CPWD percentage-rate format, 2023. Pages contain Telugu, Hindi and English, key dates in a table, and India-specific eligibility (CPWD/PWD registration, turnover, solvency, ESI/EPF/GST, EMD with MSE exemption). Publicly posted Indian government tender. Reuse terms for tender documents are unclear (GODL covers datasets), so only the answer key is stored here; run `python -m evals.fetch` to rebuild the text locally from the official source.

requirements.quote: Last Date & Time of Bid submission. 07.06.2023, 11.00 AM
The original EMD should be submitted in the office of Construction Branch
Period for submission of original EMD/ Eligibility documents by the Lowest Bidder Within one week from the date of opening the financial bid
Period of Completion 12 Months
The bidder should have registration with CPWD/State PWD /MES/Railways/BSNL
The Bidder should have satisfactorily completed similar works during the last Seven years
This should be certified by an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer/Project Manager
shall upload two separate letters for experience certificate and affidavit
Average Annual Financial Turn over of Rs.14,97,536-00
The bidder should not have incurred any loss (profit after tax should be positive) in more than two years
The solvency of Rs bidder should have Rs11,98,028-00
The past experience in similar nature of work should be supported by certificates issued by the client’s organisation
The tenderer must be registered with following statutory authorities and must also furnish self attested copies ESI, EPF, GST along with last six months payment receipts
an affidavit in this matter to be enclosed / uploaded that firm has never been employed
The Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) for Rs.59,901-00(Rupees Fifty nine thousand nine hundred and one only) Which shall be in the form of Insurance Surety Bonds
The bids need to be submitted along with all required and relevant documents related to works experience, financial strength
submission of bids by any other mode other than online mode bids will not be accepted
Conditional bid will not to be accepted
The tender for the work shall remain open for acceptance by ESI Corporation for a period 60 days
The bidder must ensure to quote the percentage above or below or at par to two places of decimal only both in figures as well as in words
The total amount of the offer corresponding to the percentages quoted by the bidder shall also be mentioned both in words and figures
The bidder does not upload all the documents (including GST Registration) as stipulated in the bid document
Copy of EMD.
Letter of Transmittal.
Certificate of Work Experience as per Form – A
